annotations.title: Stock Expert AI: compare stocks side by side

description:
Compare 2-4 US stocks on Stock Expert AI's own metrics: MoonshotScore, Council Score, band, the five pillar scores (business quality, financial safety, valuation, growth durability, momentum; 0-100 against frozen sector norms, 50 = the sector's typical company), sector, industry — plus a rule-based verdict sentence that states which ticker leads on how many metrics and makes no recommendation. Price, market cap and P/E are not returned: full figures on the comparison page (canonicalUrl).

Covers questions such as "CRM vs NOW", "AMD or NVDA, which scores higher", "compare AAPL MSFT GOOGL".
Args: tickers (array of 2-4 strings).
Returns (structuredContent): { asOf, verdict, metrics: [{ metric, values: {TICKER: value}, leader }], summaries: [one per-stock summary per ticker], missing, canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }.
Errors: fewer than two tickers resolved → lists which ones were unknown.
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.

tickers.description: Two to four US ticker symbols

items.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, BRK.B, AAPL (case-insensitive)
